try: Open a contract on your phone: it opens as the document, not the editor
how:
1. On your phone (the Network address from chapter 12), tap "Tools" › "Contracts"
2. Tap the card "Olivia Martinez" (Interior Design Service Agreement, Draft)
3. Read the top of the screen, then scroll to the end
expect: The contract opens as a screen: a back arrow, "Olivia Martinez" with "Interior Design Service Agreement · from OM-10001" under it, ⋮ at the right. A card holds the Draft chip, From template, the contract date as a row, the quote row (OM-10001 · its amount · its status) and Olivia with Call, WhatsApp and a pencil. One "Next" line says what the contract needs. The clauses are cards split at the headings (the first open, the rest folded), the signature boxes a last card. Rows for Signature fields, Before the client signs, Automation, Files and Activity follow. A foot stays at the bottom with "Edit" and "Send". Nothing scrolls sideways.
in10: Different from 1.0: a contract on a phone opens as the document; the editor comes on Edit

try: Edit is a short list; Details is one form
how:
1. Tap "Edit"
2. Read the list
3. Tap "Details"; change the contract date (the calendar) and the recipient's number; tap the back arrow
4. Tap "Done"
expect: Edit opens a short list: Details, Document, Signature fields, Before the client signs, Automation, Files — each with a one-line summary. Details is one form (title, recipient and number, contract date, the quote, issued by) that types at 16 and saves by itself; the calendar's days are big enough for a finger. The arrow returns to the list; Done returns to the contract, whose card now reads the new date and number.
in10: Different from 1.0: the four things that change on site in one form

try: The Document screen: the paper full screen with one row of tools
how:
1. Edit › "Document"
2. Read the bar and the row of tools
3. Tap into clause 2, type a word, tap "B"
4. Tap "+" in the tool row › "Insert a field" › "Client phone"
5. Tap a lilac field chip in the text
6. Tap the outline (≡) and pick a clause; tap "Done"
expect: The paper fills the screen under a bar (← · Document · the clause · ≡ · Done) with one row of seven big tools: Undo, Text, B, I, U, List, +. Nothing scrolls sideways and nothing covers the text (no Maison AI button here). "+" opens a sheet: Add a signature field, Link, Image, Highlight, Numbered list, the alignments, then Insert a field with what each prints as; the chip lands where the caret was with "Client phone inserted · Undo". A tap on a chip says what it prints as, with Remove. The outline jumps to the clause; Done returns to the list.
in10: Different from 1.0: seven tools at a finger's size, the rest one tap further

try: A signature field is placed by choosing where, never by a thumb
how:
1. Edit › "Signature fields"
2. On "Client initial" tap "Add"
3. Pick "Under Signatures" (already picked) and tap "Add under Signatures"
4. Tap "Undo" in the snackbar
5. Edit › "Before the client signs": tap the words of "Read to the end"
expect: Signature fields lists Studio signature, Client signature, Studio initial, Client initial as placed / not placed. Add asks where: the clauses from the outline, "Under Signatures" picked for you, "At the end". The field lands as its own block under Signatures, the screen scrolls to it with a pulse and the snackbar says "Client initial added under Signatures · Undo"; Undo takes it away. Before the client signs: the whole row toggles the switch, not only its track; the help reads at 14.
in10: Different from 1.0: no caret needed; a field goes after a clause you choose

try: Send from the phone; the state's one button after
how:
1. Back on the contract tap "Send"
2. Read the sheet without scrolling; tap "How signing works"
3. Tap "Send via WhatsApp" (WhatsApp opens with the message; come back)
4. Read the Next line and the foot; tap "Remind"
5. Tap ⋮ at the top right
expect: The sheet fits the phone: a one-line head, the recipient and number, the message, Copy link and Send via WhatsApp in the foot; "How signing works" unfolds the explanation; no "Mark as signed" line here (it is in ⋮). After sending, the Next line reads "With Olivia for signature · sent just now · not opened yet · link open until …" and the foot's button is "Remind", which opens the reminder sheet. The ⋮ is grouped (Look · Change · Share · Export) with no key hints; a snackbar never covers its rows.
in10: Same as 1.0: WhatsApp carries the link; the state decides the one button

try: A signed contract reads only; the paper as a viewer
how:
1. Tools › Contracts › "Ryan D’Souza" (Signed)
2. Read the card and the foot; open the "Signed copy" row and ⋮ › "Signing record"
3. Tap "As printed" on the document; swipe, pinch, then back
4. ⋮ › "Preview": tap "Paper"
expect: A signed contract has no Edit: the card says "Signed 31 Jul ’26 · marked by the studio", the foot offers "Download signed copy" (and Move to Won while the lead is not Won). No toolbar, no greyed tools. As printed opens the viewer (fit to width, swipe, pinch, Download); the Preview page is the reflowed paper under one bar with Paper as a toggle to the same viewer.
in10: Different from 1.0: no dead toolbar over a frozen copy

scene: The client signs on their phone
try: Read first, then one bar that walks to the signature
how:
1. Open the link you sent in 27.05 on the phone (or a phone-sized window)
2. Read the top; scroll and watch the bar
3. Tap "As cards" in the hero, then "View as printed", then Back
4. Scroll to the end
expect: A head with the studio's name, then a card: the agreement, "Signs quotation OM-10001 · S$… → As cards", "Hi Olivia, read it, then sign with a one-time code." The paper comes first, at a readable size. A bar stays at the bottom: "Read to the end to sign · 1 of 13 sections", counting as you scroll. As cards shows the quote as reading cards in place (View as printed opens the paper viewer); the phone's Back closes it without reloading. At the end the bar becomes one filled button: "Accept and sign".
in10: Different from 1.0: the paper first; the form was above it

scene: The client signs on their phone
try: Tick, code, sign — in one hand
how:
1. Tap "Accept and sign"
2. Tick the words (and the CaseTrust box), tap Continue
3. Type any six digits (the demo sends no text)
4. Read the Type screen; tap "Draw" and draw a square; tap "Clear"; go back to Type
5. Tap "Sign agreement"
expect: A sheet in three screens, one filled button each: the words to tick at a readable size; six code boxes (a real phone offers the SMS code); then your name typed in the signature face, with Draw one tap away — a square drawn stays a square, Clear sits under the pad, NRIC is folded. The consent sentence reads at 16. Sign closes the sheet and the page lands on the signature box.
in10: Different from 1.0: the code autofills; the drawn signature keeps its shape

scene: The client signs on their phone
try: Signed: keep a copy, see the record
how:
1. Read the Signed card and the bar
2. Tap "Save a copy"
3. Tap "Signing record"
4. Open a dead link: /sign/none
expect: The card reads Signed with the date; its rows are Save a copy, Pay the deposit and Signing record; the bar reads "Signed by Olivia · 22 Oct ’26". Save a copy opens the phone's share sheet with this page's address (where there is none, the link is copied and a snackbar says the page stays at it with the record and its fingerprint) — nothing prints. Signing record opens as a sheet, one tap away. A dead link's notice offers "Message Demo Studio Pte Ltd".
in10: Different from 1.0: a copy you can keep from a phone; the record one tap away

how:
1. Tools › Contracts on the phone
2. Read a card; tap its ⋮
3. Hold a card until it ticks
4. Open Olivia's lead › "Contracts" tab
expect: Each card leads with the client's name and the amount of the quote it signs; under them "Signs OM-… · Interior Design Service Agreement"; then a status chip you cannot tap (the status changes on the contract) with its since (sent · not opened · link expired · signed) and a chevron. The whole card opens the contract; holding selects. The ⋮ offers Open, Send a reminder (or Send the link again), Copy link, Mark as signed…, Stop the signing link, Change status ›, Share PDF, Archive, Delete. The to-do chips keep their words. The lead's tab shows the same cards with the title first.
in10: Different from 1.0: the client leads the card; the status is read-only

try: A new contract on your phone: who first
how:
1. Tools › Contracts › "+"
2. Pick a lead under "Who is it for?"
3. Read the rows; tap "From a template"
4. Pick the agreement and tap "Use template"
expect: The first step asks who the contract is for, recent leads first with a search. Then rows: From the studio agreement, From a template, Import from file. From a template opens the templates as a list (the suggested one picked, one button named after the pick); the contract opens as the contract screen for that lead.
in10: Different from 1.0: the lead first, then the kind

try: A template is an outline you open one clause at a time
how:
1. More › Company › Templates › Contracts on the phone
2. Read the list; tap "Interior Design Service Agreement"
3. Tap clause 4 (Defects period), fix a word, tap Done
4. Open "Before the client signs"; tap a row's ⋮ back in the list
expect: The gallery is a list with Default and At handover on top: each row the name, "13 headings · used by 5 · edited 14 Aug" and a chevron. A template opens as a reading screen: a status row ("Default · used by 5 · fills 10 fields · client signs ✓") and the clauses as rows; a clause opens full screen to edit with the same one row of tools as a contract; the signing rules are switches in their own row. The row's ⋮ offers New contract from this template, Set as default, Use at handover, Rename, Move to folder, Duplicate, Delete.
in10: Different from 1.0: never a shrunk A4, never a 3,800px text box

try: The contract inside the quote, the project and the Won step
how:
1. Tools › Quotes › Olivia's quote on the phone: read the hero
2. Projects › Ryan D’Souza's project › Overview: find "Documents"; open Money
3. Leads › a lead in Quote Sent › the stage pill › Won › "Attach client signed contract"
expect: The quote's hero has a row "Contract · Sent to Client ›" that opens the contract, and the Next line reads the contract's state. The project Overview has a Documents fold (the signed quote, the contract, each with its date and ↗); the To collect tile shows the contract total at a readable size. The Won step offers "Take a photo" (the camera) and "Choose a file": a photo of the signed paper is kept as the signed copy and the lead moves to Won.
in10: Different from 1.0: a phone's camera signs the lead off on site

try: A tablet held upright follows the phone; held sideways it holds the list beside the section
how:
1. On a tablet upright (768), open a contract and Edit
2. Turn it sideways (1024): Edit › Details; then Document; tap ≡
3. Tools › Contracts sideways: read the table's columns
expect: Upright: the contract screen in a wide column, the list and the Document screen full width, the + ▾ and Text ▾ as sheets. Sideways: the section list is a 300 pane beside the open section; Document is full width with the Outline as a pane (never a drawer over the paper); Add a signature field is a centred dialog. The list is a table with Title, Lead, Status and Sent, Title and ⋮ frozen, the title opening the contract; Column settings adds the rest, remembered for the tablet.
in10: Different from 1.0: a default set of columns on a tablet

how: 1. On the laptop at full width, open Tools › Contracts, a contract, its Preview, a template and a signing link
expect: The list, the editor (the meta row, the tool bar, the paper, eSignatures as a drawer, Insert at the caret), the Preview, the template editor and the client's signing page are as they were in chapter 8 — only the dead-link notices now offer "Message Demo Studio Pte Ltd", and the gate rows toggle on their words too.
